title: 南宋与民族英雄岳飞
subtitle: The Southern Song & National Hero Yue Fei

cards.back: to fall / perish (a country or dynasty ends)
cards.exampleTranslation: The Northern Song fell.
cards.breakdown: 灭：一横压在火上面，把火压灭了 · 亡：一个人躲进角落，藏起来不见了

cards.back: to succeed to the throne (become the new emperor)
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhao Gou became emperor.
cards.breakdown: 继：丝线（纟）不断地接续下去，一代传一代

cards.exampleTranslation: The Southern Song court was afraid of the Jin soldiers.
cards.breakdown: 廷：一个人挺立着走进大殿

cards.back: to beg for peace / sue for peace
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Gaozong wanted to make peace.

cards.back: to resist the Jin (fight against the Jin invaders)
cards.exampleTranslation: The people formed anti-Jin volunteer armies.
cards.breakdown: 抗：用手（扌）高举（亢），不肯低头

cards.exampleTranslation: The Yue Family Army was a very strong volunteer army.
cards.breakdown: 义：我心里有善良（羊），愿意牺牲自己

cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei was a famous general.
cards.breakdown: 领：发号施令（令）的那个头（页）

cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei defeated the Jin army many times.
cards.breakdown: 败：用棍子打（攵）打散了财物（贝）

cards.exampleTranslation: They recovered a lot of lost land.
cards.breakdown: 复：走回来，回到原来的地方

cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei bravely fought the Jin.
cards.breakdown: 英：植物中间开出最美的花，出类拔萃 · 勇：力量（力）像泉水一样向上涌出

cards.example: 南宋科学技术进步很大。
cards.exampleTranslation: Science and technology in the Southern Song made big progress.
cards.breakdown: 术：树（木）里面有一个核心，那是技术的精髓

cards.example: 活字印刷术是中国伟大的发明。
cards.exampleTranslation: Movable type printing is a great Chinese invention.
cards.breakdown: 印：用手往下压，把印章盖在纸上 · 术：树（木）里面有一个核心，那是技术的精髓

cards.exampleTranslation: Gunpowder was used in the military.
cards.breakdown: 药：用草药（艹）制成的东西，能控制（约）病情

cards.back: Song Ci poetry (beautiful Chinese poems from Song times)
cards.example: 宋词是中国文学的瑰宝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Song Ci is a treasure of Chinese literature.
Qingming Shanghe Tu is a painting treasure.
cards.breakdown: 瑰：玉石（王旁）里藏着鬼魅般的光芒，珍奇无比

cards.example: 两宋在文学和绘画上都有成就。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Song dynasties had achievements in literature and painting.
cards.breakdown: 就：在高处（京）用行动（攵）成就了出众（尤）的事

cards.exampleTranslation: Commerce in the Song dynasties was very prosperous.
cards.breakdown: 繁：无数的丝线（糸）密密麻麻交织在一起 · 荣：树木（木）燃烧着生命的火焰，蓬勃生长

cards.exampleTranslation: Song commerce was very developed.
There were lively night markets in the city.

cards.back: standing everywhere (like lots of shops in a row)
cards.exampleTranslation: Shops stood everywhere in the streets and alleys.
Overseas trade flourished in the Song.
cards.breakdown: 贸：打开门（卯）用钱财（贝）做生意

cards.exampleTranslation: Chinese ships exported porcelain.
cards.breakdown: 瓷：比瓦（瓦）更精致的陶器

cards.exampleTranslation: They mainly exported porcelain and silk.
cards.breakdown: 绸：丝线（纟）绕来绕去（周）织成的布

cards.back: Yue Fei – brave general and national hero
Qin Hui – the sneaky prime minister who betrayed Yue Fei
Kublai Khan – Mongol ruler who ended the Song Dynasty
